title: 05｜用户首 token 与兜底体验
description: 业务首token：用户提交到第一个token实际显示，包含首发等待和兜底全过程。按所选型号统计，缺报不补0，无AI自动调参。

list.name: measurement
list.label: 观测口径
list.query: 修复后 v2 : visible_dom_after_frame_v2,历史 v1 : visible_dom_after_frame_v1

list.name: model
list.label: 型号
list.query: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id) || ' [' || requested_model_id || ']' AS __text, requested_model_id AS __value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))) GROUP BY requested_model_id ORDER BY 1

options.content:
**优先看两项**：①完全无字、因首发/兜底/总时限截断的比例，目标1%；②点击发送到首个可见token的分布，包含已开启的思考文字。

默认首发派发后4秒、兜底派发后2秒、用户总上限10秒；4+2不是用户总耗时。下方保留每轮真实配置和样本数。其他上游错误单列；缺报、后台、主动取消不算成功，结合覆盖率判断。

默认**修复后v2**，历史v1的显示检测可能漏判，分开查看。分布只取前台实际显示记录，不用供应商latency或服务端写出时间替代；无字请求不填0秒。

panels.title: 完全无字 · 时间截断率 · 各型号
panels.description: 主指标，目标1%。正文或开启的思考曾实际可见即不算无字；首发/兜底提前超时与用户总上限截断都计入。分母为前台已知结果，其他上游失败保留在分母但不混入时间截断。结合覆盖率和样本数看。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), concat(COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id), ' [', requested_model_id, ']') AS metric, 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome='timed_out' OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,requested_model_id UNION ALL SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), '监控目标' AS metric, 100.0*max(timeout_rate_target) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 点击 → 首个可见 token（含思考）· 耗时分布
panels.description: 按所选型号筛选后的前台已显示样本计算占比，正文或开启的可见思考均计首token。只使用浏览器提交到可见DOM获得绘制机会的耗时。无字、缺报不填成0秒，须与左侧时间截断率一起看；未选择单型号时为所选请求合并分布。

targets.rawSql:
WITH samples AS (SELECT client_first_token_visible_ms AS ms FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false),
bins(ord,label,lo,hi) AS (VALUES (1,'0–1秒',0,1000),(2,'1–2秒',1000,2000),(3,'2–3秒',2000,3000),(4,'3–4秒',3000,4000),(5,'4–6秒',4000,6000),(6,'6–8秒',6000,8000),(7,'8–10秒',8000,10000),(8,'10秒及以上',10000,NULL))
SELECT b.label AS "点击到首token", 100.0*count(s.ms)/NULLIF((SELECT count(*) FROM samples),0) AS "已显示样本占比"
FROM bins b LEFT JOIN samples s ON s.ms>=b.lo AND (b.hi IS NULL OR s.ms<b.hi) GROUP BY b.ord,b.label ORDER BY b.ord

panels.title: 每型号业务总览
panels.description: 无字时间截断率＝前台未见任何正文/思考且因首发、兜底或总上限终止的请求 / 前台已知结果（已显示＋时间截断＋其他上游失败）。其他错误单列；取消、后台、缺报不算成功。分组保留当轮首发/兜底/总预算。

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id) AS "型号", count(*) AS "请求量", 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome='timed_out' OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS "无字时间截断率",
 percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false)/1000.0 AS "用户总首 token P90",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE fallback_started)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "兜底触发率",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='timed_out' AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS "前台已知结果超时率",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome<>'missing')/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "回报覆盖率",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "旧总截止口径可判定占比",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "前台已看到样本",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='timed_out' AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "前台超时样本",
 percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false)/1000.0 AS "用户总首 token P50",
 percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false)/1000.0 AS "用户总首 token P95",
 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE delivery_role='fallback' AND client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS "已看到样本中兜底占比",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='missing') AS "缺报请求",
 count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='not_observed') AS "其他未观测请求", requested_model_id AS "目录型号ID", primary_timeout_ms/1000.0 AS "首发等待",fallback_timeout_ms/1000.0 AS "兜底等待",first_token_deadline_ms/1000.0 AS "总等待上限",
100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome='timed_out' OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false),0) AS "最终无字失败率",
count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome='timed_out' OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "最终无字失败样本",
percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_wait_finished_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_backgrounded=false)/1000.0 AS "含失败的实际等待 P90"
, count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome='timed_out' OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "无字时间截断样本", count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false) AS "前台已知结果样本", 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE (client_outcome IN ('observed','timed_out') OR (client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason IN ('upstream_error','server_timeout','primary_timeout','fallback_timeout'))) AND client_backgrounded=false)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS "前台已知结果占比", count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_backgrounded=false AND client_outcome='not_observed' AND client_reason='upstream_error') AS "其他错误无字样本"
FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring}))
GROUP BY requested_model_id,primary_timeout_ms,fallback_timeout_ms,first_token_deadline_ms ORDER BY count(*) DESC,requested_model_id

旧总截止口径可判定占比

panels.title: 用户总首 token P90 · 各型号
panels.description: 每5分钟前台实际看到首token的P90。它已经包括首发等待和兜底，不由两段P90相加。没有报告或未显示时不补技术耗时。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), concat(COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id), ' [', requested_model_id, ']') AS metric, percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP(ORDER BY client_first_token_visible_ms) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome='observed' AND client_backgrounded=false)/1000.0 AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,requested_model_id ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 兜底触发率 · 各型号
panels.description: 已触发兜底的请求/全部有效请求，包含触发后仍超时或失败的请求；不是只看成功兜底。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), concat(COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id), ' [', requested_model_id, ']') AS metric, 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE fallback_started)/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,requested_model_id ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 客户端回报覆盖率 · 各型号
panels.description: 收到任意客户端最终报告的请求/全部有效请求。已报告的取消、错误也计覆盖，不等于首token已看到；可判定占比与成功/超时样本数见总览。

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(request_received_at,'5m'), concat(COALESCE(NULLIF(string_agg(DISTINCT requested_provider_model_id, ' / ' ORDER BY requested_provider_model_id),''),requested_model_id), ' [', requested_model_id, ']') AS metric, 100.0*count(*) FILTER(WHERE client_outcome<>'missing')/NULLIF(count(*),0) AS value FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_facts WHERE $__timeFilter(request_received_at) AND NOT billing_rejected AND (measurement_method=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (client_outcome='missing' AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND fallback_timeout_ms IS NULL)))) AND ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR requested_model_id IN (${model:sqlstring})) GROUP BY 1,requested_model_id ORDER BY 1,2

panels.title: 人工调整对照 · 同型号按当轮等待配置分组
panels.description: 同型号按配置版本、首发等待、兜底等待、总上限、兜底型号分组；型号总体150门槛不代替各参数组样本量。只比较同一型号。

targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(j->>'provider_model_id',''),j->>'model_id') AS "型号",(j->>'model_requests')::int AS "型号总请求",(j->>'sample_eligible')::boolean AS "型号达到150样本",(j->>'requests')::int AS "本组请求",(j->>'primary_timeout_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "首发等待",(j->>'first_token_deadline_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "总等待上限",(j->>'fallback_timeout_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "兜底等待",j->>'fallback_model_id' AS "兜底型号",(j->>'user_first_token_p90_ms')::numeric/1000.0 AS "用户总首 token P90",100*(j->>'fallback_start_rate')::numeric AS "兜底触发率",100*(j->>'foreground_first_token_failure_rate_known')::numeric AS "最终无字失败率",100*(j->>'foreground_time_cutoff_rate_known')::numeric AS "无字时间截断率",100*(j->>'client_report_coverage')::numeric AS "回报覆盖率",(j->>'catalog_version')::int AS "配置版本",j->>'model_id' AS "目录型号ID" FROM miniapp_analytics.chat_first_token_report($__timeFrom(),$__timeTo()) j WHERE ('__all__' IN (${model:sqlstring}) OR j->>'model_id' IN (${model:sqlstring})) AND (j->>'measurement_method'=${measurement:sqlstring} OR (j->>'measurement_method' IS NULL AND ((${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v2' AND j->>'fallback_timeout_ms' IS NOT NULL) OR (${measurement:sqlstring}='visible_dom_after_frame_v1' AND j->>'fallback_timeout_ms' IS NULL)))) ORDER BY j->>'model_id',(j->>'catalog_version')::int,(j->>'primary_timeout_ms')::int

matcher.options: 已看到样本中兜底占比
